title: Mapping global floods with 10 years of satellite radar data — Nature Communications
snippet: A Nature Communications study presents a global flood mapping dataset derived from 10 years of satellite radar (SAR) data, primarily from Sentinel-1 and ALOS-2 PALSAR-2. The research provides the most comprehensive spatio-temporal record of flood extent worldwide, enabling improved flood risk assessment, climate adaptation planning, and validation of hydrological models. The dataset covers 2014-2024 and reveals trends in flood frequency and extent linked to climate change patterns.
tag_reason: New peer-reviewed global flood mapping dataset using 10 years of SAR data. Foundational dataset for flood risk and climate adaptation research.
